title: Quick Chinese Salmon with Biryani Rice
description: A flavorful and nutritious Chinese-inspired salmon dish served with a side of savory biryani rice. Ready in under 30 minutes!
instructions: Season the salmon fillet with salt and pepper.
In a pan, heat the quick-cooking oil over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and ginger, cook for 1 minute.
Place the salmon fillet in the pan, skin side up.
Pour the savory soy sauce over the salmon, making sure it's fully coated.
Transfer the pan to the preheated oven and bake for 12-15 minutes.
While the salmon is cooking, cook the biryani rice according to package instructions.
Garnish with green onions and serve with the cooked biryani rice.
